acceptanceCriteria.text: Documentation contains one explicit Route → artifact/implementation → execution substrate mapping.

Route 4 identifies Rust `mottainai-init` as the bootstrap implementation vehicle.
QEMU provisioning is explicitly distinguished from QEMU lifecycle ownership.
ADR-0003 dependency direction and previously accepted Lima ownership boundary remain unchanged.
